notes.title: Deedlee Doo! Carkour! 1.21
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Corrected the text to consistently say “Catsle” not “Castle” since it’s a cat pun.
[*] Halved the time it takes to get a Coolness Point in “Capture the Catsle” mode but doubled the amount to win from 50 to 100.
[*] Made rockets use predictive physics so they don’t hitch based on network ticks
[*] Added a Streamer Mode that obscures names above players and in all of the other UI elements (win screens, player list in Capture the Catsle)
[*] Set more variables to replicate for the capture volume to prevent score desyncs in Capture the Catsle
[/list]

notes.title: New MP Mode Live! King of the Catsle! Stay on top of the Cat to win!
notes.notes:
The new MP mode King of the Catsle is now live.

Compete with up to 32 other players to stay on top of the Cat.

If you are the only one on the Cat you earn Coolness Points. The first player to 50 points wins the round.

notes.title: Multiplayer is now live!
notes.notes:
"Deedlee Doo! Carkour!" now has multiplayer support.

To start with, you can run Public and Private matches in the main racing mode. Whoever finishes the game first wins. It will show other players the winner's time and how many times they had to reset.

Cars can collide with each other and you can use your rockets to blast other player's off-course.

Currently this supports up to 32 players.

Additional game modes like Deathmeowtch and King of the Catsle (yes it's spelled that way on purpose haha) will be coming soon!

If you have any feedback, feel free to hop on the [url=https://discord.gg/MYEM6uM9mq]Discord[/url]! This game is Early Access so more is coming soon! I hope you all have fun with it!

Lots of other changes and fixes have gone in as well, you can read the full patch notes [url=https://www.justpurkeygames.com/patchnotes]here[/url].

notes.title: Deedlee Doo! Carkour! 1.02 - Released on May 16 2025
notes.notes:
Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Reset checkpoints so they can be used again if you restart from the beginning.
[*] Made sure first double jump tutorial is covering a bigger area.
[*] Added arrows to the tutorial arrow so people don’t get turned around.
[*] Moved the helper tips up a bit more on the screen
[*] Added a tip to not push the stick when you’re jumping unless you want to tilt your car.
[*] Made the main controls UI show up earlier in the tutorial
[*] Fixed the logic for how the Lumen Checkbox saves. It was turning itself back on.
[/list]

notes.title: Deedlee Doo! Carkour! 1.01 Released
notes.notes:
Deedlee Doo! Carkour! 1.01 - Released on May 15 2025

Here are the changes:
[olist]
[*] Raised up the location that players reset to at checkpoints to prevent them from possibly getting stuck in some cases.
[*] Reset the player’s rotation before trying to reset their position. This was causing players at weird angles to be unable to reset until they straightened out their car.
[*] Fixed some cases where if a player would fall back down to a previous region, weather wouldn’t reset. Also made sure all checkpoints had the proper weathers if you were resuming from a save.
[*] Turned on Async Physics to prevent cases where the player would sometimes clip through things if moving at a high velocity.
[*] Made Checkpoints always loaded so that the player can see them from further away.
[*] Refined the collision on the pillars so that the player doesn’t clip into them.
[*] Fixed the logic for inverting controls. It would be in a weird state the very first time the player played the game.
[*] Temporarily removed the localization dropdown from the options menu until that actually exists in the game.
[/olist]
